DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Avulsion Fracture of the Extensor Tendon)

This diagnosis fits your history of forceful flexion after a jammed finger, the "pop" you heard, and now the inability to actively straighten your distal finger tip. Even though the MRI shows the tendons are intact, the specific loss of extension at the DIP joint with swelling suggests the tendon has pulled off a small piece of bone, which the X-ray might have missed.
